local c=game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
local h=c and c:FindFirstChild("Head")
local r=c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
assert(h and r)
local rows={}
for _,v in c:GetDescendants() do if v:IsA("MeshPart") then table.insert(rows,{name=v.Name,size={v.Size.X,v.Size.Y,v.Size.Z},rootOffset={r.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(v.Position).X,r.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(v.Position).Y,r.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(v.Position).Z}}) end end
return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode({headSize={h.Size.X,h.Size.Y,h.Size.Z},headRootOffset={r.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(h.Position).X,r.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(h.Position).Y,r.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(h.Position).Z},meshes=rows})
